pending.body: Hi Firstmate, I am back through Jobs. Are you there? Please answer here.

reply.body: Yes, I'm here. Away mode has ended and I'm back on the fleet. There was nothing waiting on you, and no tasks were live. The only flag is a brief watcher downtime gap during the away window, and it has recovered.
